clips.caption:
Long before anyone argued about free speech online, the fight was over something simpler: who got to read.

For most of history, only priests and pharaohs could. Everyone else took their word for it - 'this is what the gods have said, it is written' - because there was no way to check. When regular people finally learned to read, the ones in power didn't stop controlling information. They just switched to banning the books, and burning the people who wrote them.

The method changed. The goal never did: keep you from reading the thing that would set you free.
